title: fix(auth): a session that ended on the server returns to sign-in on the next in-app navigation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x1oXStE7GxT1aiLKwuoMqA7)_

Fixes #32138

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 控制台里任何 API 请求回 401 时，`createAuthenticatedFetch` 发一个信号；`AuthProvider` 收到后向服务器确认一次会话。服务器说"没有会话"，就清掉登录状态，路由守卫把用户送到 `/login?redirect=当前页`，和整页刷新走的是同一个地方。
- **为什么改:** 会话在服务器端结束(别处登出、过期、被吊销)后，站内点击一直停在已登录的外壳里，页面显示"页面不存在"或"请检查网络"，只有刷新才回登录页。
- **风险与回滚:** 401 只是线索，服务器确认才算数：403、404 不触发；会话仍有效时(某个接口单独拒绝)页面不动；确认请求没得到回答(断网)保留会话；没有会话时(登录页)忽略 401，不会循环跳转。回滚即 revert 本 PR，纯前端，不涉及服务器与元数据。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx`(新增的独立 effect，不改 `loadSession`)、`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts`(401 分支)、控制台点击测试的新 describe。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/ProtectedRoute.signOutListState-29174.test.tsx`，预期 12/12 通过；在 `origin/main` 的源码上同一文件有 3 例失败，失败现场停在 "Page Not Found"。
- **需要你做的:** 无，等席位审核后由席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/auth/src/session-end-events.ts` (new): a module-level emitter, the same shape as `auth-gate-events.ts`, so the plain fetch wrapper stays free of React.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts`: a `401` answered to an API call (`isApiCall`, the same condition that decided the request carried our credentials) emits on it. The response still reaches the caller unchanged.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx`: one new, self-contained effect. While a session is held it subscribes; on a `401` it asks `getSession()` once. Only an answered "no session" clears `user` / `session` (and purges the signed-out user's client caches, as `loadSession` does on the same answer). An unanswered read (`sessionReadWasInconclusive`) keeps the session. A burst of `401`s collapses to one read, and a read already in flight (mount, rotation, `refreshSession`) answers for them. `loadSession` and the sign-in methods are not reshaped.
- The redirect itself is the existing one: `AuthGuard` renders its fallback, which in the Console is `LoginRedirect` (`ProtectedRoute.tsx`, unchanged), so the visitor lands on `/login?redirect=CURRENT_PAGE` exactly as the reload path does. Because `sessionEndedBySignOut` stays false on this path, the return link is kept.
- `ui/packages/auth/README.md`: one paragraph under `createAuthenticatedFetch` on the new behaviour.
- `.changeset/32138-session-end-returns-to-login.md`: `patch` on `@object-ui/auth`.

Not touched: `createAuthClient.ts`, `LoginForm`, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/**`, `AuthShell.tsx`, `MetadataProvider.tsx` and the list error state. One seam covers both of the card's symptoms (the page lookup and the object list both read over `createAuthenticatedFetch` through `AdapterProvider`), so no page-level patch was needed.

## Why

The full-reload path reaches the login page because the boot's `get-session` answers "no session" and `AuthGuard` renders `LoginRedirect`. In-app navigation never asked again: every data and metadata call answered `401`, and each consumer rendered that as its own error ("Page Not Found", "Couldn't load records … Check your connection"). Reacting at the fetch seam that every one of those calls already rides gives one place for the decision, and the re-check keeps a single endpoint's `401` from ending a live session.

## Tests

Reproduced on `origin/main` (`8523ef9a`) first, with the new console block and the `@object-ui/auth` sources restored to `main`:

<details><summary>Before (main sources): 3 failed / 9 passed</summary>

```
× the session ended on the server: a click on a Home tile lands on /login with the page as ?redirect=
× a 401 while the server still holds the session keeps the person on the page
× on the login page a 401 changes nothing: no session re-check, no redirect loop
Test Files  1 failed (1)
     Tests  3 failed | 9 passed (12)
```

The first failure's DOM is the card's symptom: `data-testid="metadata-page"` reading `Page Not Found`, no login form. (The third fails on `main` in its setup, which needs the redirect first; the second pins the new re-check.)

</details>

<details><summary>After (this branch): 51 / 51</summary>

```
pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/ProtectedRoute.signOutListState-29174.test.tsx packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx packages/auth/src/__tests__/createAuthenticatedFetch.test.tsx
Test Files  3 passed (3)
     Tests  51 passed (51)
```

</details>

New pins, each as a top-level `describe` in the component's existing harness file:

- `ProtectedRoute.signOutListState-29174.test.tsx` (real `AuthProvider`, real `ProtectedRoute`, real Console `LoginPage`, a real router Link click, a real `Response` per status): session ended → `/login?redirect=%2Fapps%2Fdemo%2Fpage%2Fshowcase_capability_map`; `403` and real `404` still render the page's own state and ask nothing; `401` with a live session stays on the page after one re-check; on the login page a `401` re-checks nothing and the URL does not move.
- `AuthProvider.test.tsx` (real `createAuthenticatedFetch`, real `createAuthClient` with `get-session` scripted at its fetch seam): "no session" clears identity; a live session is kept; a transport error on the re-check keeps the session; no session held asks nothing.
- `createAuthenticatedFetch.test.tsx`: a `401` on an API call is reported and still returned; `200`/`403`/`404`/`500` are not; a non-API URL and a cross-origin URL under `sameOriginOnly` are not.

Against `main` sources the two auth files read 4 failed / 35 passed (the four new-behaviour pins).

## Acceptance notes

- A `401` from an endpoint that refuses for its own reasons while the session is live costs one `get-session` per burst. No cooldown beyond the in-flight collapse was added.
- `createAuthenticatedFetch` without `sameOriginOnly` already attaches credentials to a cross-origin URL containing `/api/`; a `401` from such a host now triggers one harmless re-check (the session stays). Recorded, not changed.
